Compare transition-only, SASRec-only, and confidence-gated combinations to test whether explicit local evidence improves on the previous fusion results. Use training-only counts, with queried occurrences removed for transition diagnostics; select using pinned macro validation HR@10.

Treat compatibility and duplicate-function detection as hypotheses requiring evidence, not properties guaranteed by text similarity.

searches.reason: Challenge whether feature fusion addresses the main limitation: Electronics has 22.3% negative training margins, while normalized fusion previously underperformed. Research candidate-ranking objectives and efficient negative sampling as an alternative to added architecture. Compare uniform multi-negative cross-entropy with controlled hard-negative sampling, accounting for false negatives; training margins alone cannot establish validation gains.
